protocol.inner_roots: Every fixture-declared deepest face; no best-root selection
protocol.state_handling: All labeled states kept; orbits only counted, never used to merge pieces
protocol.work_measure: 4 attempts per previous labeled frontier state; includes rejected extensions
protocol.independent_prefix_oracle: All original-label BFS roots for maps with <=7 faces
protocol.exact_width_oracle: All connected-prefix orders from each root for maps with <=10 faces
protocol.oracle_scope: width optimum is not a state-count or runtime optimum
